markets.name: Chewelah Farmers Market
markets.about: The Chewelah Farmers Market is a non-profit and is run entirely by volunteers. The market is known for its vendor-friendly policies. Many of our vendors will tell you that this is their favorite market! And our monthly special event days have garnered a following all of their own
